evidence.excerpt: Before accessing the live website, Baya compiles the user's request into an executable Python program that calls a Trusted Website API.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On WASP, a security benchmark for web agents, Baya achieves 0% attack success rate, compared with 16.2% for API-enabled ReAct and 25.5% for browser-only ReAct.
